title: Pinned drag stage is pin_reorder + pin_reorder_archived + pin_press kept in step by hand
trigger: Press on a pinned row (pin_press), first drag move (pin_reorder + pin_reorder_archived set), release (reorder.release), settle (pin_reorder cleared in sidebar render at sidebar.rs:330)
effect: pin_reorder_archived is read after pin_reorder is gone (finish_pin_drag, sidebar) and pin_press survives a click that never became a drag; today the id compare in pin_drag_move guards it
fix: enum PinDrag { Idle, Pressed{chat,y}, Dragging{archived, reorder} } so the list flag and the press live inside the stage.

title: Peek preview stage is preview + preview_press (long-press token) cleared by hand in 9 places
trigger: Mouse down on a row starts preview_press + a timer; 500 ms later preview opens; mouse up, esc, reorder drag, top-people tiles each clear one or both
effect: Any writer that clears only one leaves a press with no preview or a preview that esc_stack still counts; today token compare (chat, Instant) protects the timer
fix: enum PeekPreview { Idle, Pressing{chat,started}, Open(ChatPreviewState) }.

title: Multi-select mode is implied by a non-empty HashSet<i64> of bare chat ids (selecting_chats/rows_selecting derive the mode)
trigger: Long-press/select chats; the last uncheck leaves selecting mode; ids are plain i64 with no owner key
effect: Mode and members are one value in practice, but the set is not cleared by the chat disappearing from the list (a removed/archived chat stays counted in the bulk bar) and is not keyed by list (main vs archive)
fix: enum ListSelection { Off, On(BTreeSet<ChatId>) } pruned on list rebuild.

title: Sidebar tab held as two mutually exclusive bools (contacts_tab_open, calls_tab_open) kept in step by hand at ~10 sites
trigger: n/a (see the folder-step bug for the live consequence)
effect: Every writer must remember to clear the other flag; both true is representable
fix: `tab: SidebarTab` enum.

title: Chat look wallpaper choice is three Option/bool fields (background, file, remove_wallpaper) cleared by hand in 4 click handlers
trigger: Pick a gallery tile, then From file, then Remove: each handler (chat_look_ui.rs:238,611,772 and the grid) must reset the other two
effect: Any missed reset gives two choices at once; plan_changes silently prefers file over background over remove
fix: enum WallpaperChoice { Keep, Installed(i64), File(PathBuf), Remove } in ChatLookDialog.

title: Inline-mode dropdown is open/selected/armed/waiting fields plus a token in ComposerUi
trigger: Type @bot query, change text, switch chat, bot resolve answer lands.
effect: inline_results_open, inline_results_selected, inline_query_armed, inline_query_waiting (and composer_ui.inline_query_token) are stages of one query flow reset by hand in sync_inline_mode, close_inline_results, inline_grid and the timer.
fix: One enum InlineQuery { Closed, Resolving{username}, Armed{username,query,token}, InFlight/Waiting, Shown{selected} }.

title: History width is probed/width/layout/pane_width cells set by the paint probe
trigger: Open a chat, resize the window.
effect: width_probed is a started flag deciding whether seed_history_width or the paint probe owns width; the cells are kept in step by canvas paint callbacks.
fix: One enum HistoryWidthSource { Seeded(w), Measured(w) } with the layout derived from it.

title: Main window close state is closed_by_user plus hide_after_full_screen plus a polling task
trigger: Close the main window in full screen on a Mac: hide_after_full_screen is set, a 3 s poll waits; raising the window or Cmd-Tab clears one flag but not the other; closed_by_user is never cleared.
effect: Two bools in a Global describe one of: Open, ClosedHidden, LeavingFullScreenThenHide; closed_by_user stays true forever after the first close.
fix: enum MainWindowState { Shown, LeavingFullScreen(task), Hidden } on the Global.

title: Which kit dialog a window shows is mirrored in QuillShell::open_dialog, the ChatWindows dialog map and the kit layer
trigger: sync_host_dialogs keeps open_dialog, windows.dialog_opened_in/closed_in and the kit dialog layer in step; main_window.dialogs_closed is a bool taken once to reset open_dialog after a switch.
effect: No bug today; any path that closes the kit dialog without on_close_kind or the sync leaves open_dialog naming a dialog that is gone.
fix: A single per-window DialogHost enum (None, Shown(kind)) owned by the window slot, with the kit layer driven only from it.

title: save_pending bool plus detached timer task
trigger: Move or close a chat window, then switch account or log out within 600 ms.
effect: save_pending is the stage of the debounce task; it is cleared only by the continuation, which is dropped on epoch change (harmless today because ChatWindows is replaced with the screen).
fix: Own the debounce as Option<Task> in ChatWindows (Idle|Scheduled(Task)) so dropping the task is the way out.

title: ChatWindowView::closed is a bool kept in step by hand with ChatWindows::open membership and Session::window_chats
trigger: Window lifecycle: closing(), mark_closed() (switch), render's !alive path and when_window_goes each set it; chat_window_closed removes the entry from ChatWindows.
effect: No bug found today, but 'bookkeeping ran' is stored in the view while the app's list is the truth; a missed mark_closed would run chat_window_closed for the new account's windows.
fix: One `WindowLife { Open, Closing, Gone }` owned by ChatWindows per window (the view asks it), or derive closed from ChatWindows::open membership.

title: Clear-calls box is two fields: clear_calls_open and clear_calls_revoke, reset by hand
trigger: open_clear_calls sets open=true then revoke=false; the three closers (on_close, Cancel, confirm_clear_calls) clear only `open`, leaving revoke set until the next open.
effect: No wrong state today (revoke is reset on open), but the checkbox value of a closed box lives on and the box's mode is two fields.
fix: `clear_calls: Option<ClearCallsBox { revoke: bool }>`, so closing drops the checkbox with the box.

title: Silent send passes its option through a field set before and reset after the call
trigger: Silent send shortcut
effect: send_silent_once is set, submit_from_send_button runs, then it is reset to false instead of restored; correct today only because every waiting send copies SendOnce, any new deferred reader of the field sends loud
fix: Pass SendOnce as an argument of submit_composer instead of a field the caller toggles (with_send_once restores, this site resets).

title: CommunitiesUi runs three flows as separate Options (open, ban_wait, new_chat_for) plus row_menu
trigger: Ban from a moderation menu while a box is open, or Create a New Chat from the chooser
effect: The stages of one community flow live in three fields: ban_wait waits for session state, new_chat_for waits for another subsystem's NewChat view; each is cleared by its own drain and by nothing when its owner goes away
fix: One enum CommunityFlow { None, Box(CommunityBox), BanAsking(PendingBan), NewChat{community_id} } with the drains matching on it.

title: UndoAction keeps the answer, a started Instant used as token and a timer Task as three parts
trigger: Add or Decline a pending request
effect: The wake is matched to the action by Instant equality; the action is sent by 3 paths (timer, next answer, box replace) each of which must take() it first
fix: A request-answer id in UndoAction (counter) instead of Instant, and one send_if_due path used by all three triggers.

title: edit_replace_as_file lives beside the edit it belongs to
trigger: toggle_edit_replace_as_file in an edit, then leave the edit by clear_edit, finish_edit_restore_draft or a chat change.
effect: composer_ui.edit_replace_as_file is reset only by begin_edit and clear_edit_replacement, not by leave_edit_mode or enter_chat_ui; it relies on the next begin_edit to reset it.
fix: Move it into EditMode (or ComposerEdit::media_edit) so leaving the edit drops it.

title: prev_text is hand-synced across nine writers beside markdown_revert
trigger: Programmatic set_value (set_composer_markup in begin_edit/clear_edit/cancel, rich editor, drafts) emits no Change.
effect: composer_ui.prev_text is updated only in the Change path and at some of the set_value sites (drafts.rs, rich_draft, system_replace, field revert); set_composer_markup does not, so the next keystroke diffs against a stale text for markdown/instant/system replacement.
fix: One 'field content changed' funnel (set_composer_markup) that sets prev_text and clears markdown_revert, or derive prev from the field's own undo state.

title: focus_on_mount bool on the link and Code Language dialogs is a one-shot 'mounted yet' stage
trigger: Open either box; the dialog panel's first frame takes the flag with take_link_focus / take_code_language_focus.
effect: If the box is never drawn (locked, hidden window) the flag stays set and focus is taken at an unexpected later frame. No bug found today.
fix: Dialog stage enum (Opening | Open) or move focus into the open call via a deferred focus handle.

title: edit_replace_as_file is state of the edit but lives in ComposerUi and is reset by hand
trigger: Start an edit (begin_edit resets it), toggle 'Send as a document', cancel the edit by any path other than clear_edit_replacement.
effect: The bool is cleared at copy_inline_text.rs:85 and :177 only; cancel_edit / chat change leave it set until the next begin_edit. Any new path that stages a replacement without begin_edit would start as a document.
fix: Move the flag into the edit's media_edit state (ChatUi EditMode) so ending the edit ends it.

title: send_silent_once / send_effect_once are one-shot arguments passed through fields
trigger: send_with_effect, silent shortcut, schedule-then-send set the fields, call submit, then reset to false/0 (send_effects/mod.rs:305-309, command_shortcuts.rs:89-91, scheduled.rs:399-401); with_send_once swaps them for a send that waited.
effect: Correct only because every caller resets after a synchronous call; the resets are unconditional (they also clobber an outer value) and an early return or a new async step between set and reset would leak the option into the next send.
fix: Pass SendOnce as a parameter of the submit path instead of stashing it in ComposerUi.

title: draft_restore_pending is a request flag taken by the next frame
trigger: A topic or thread switch from a menu calls request_draft_restore; restore_draft_if_pending runs in window_upkeep.
effect: The flag is not tied to the slot it was asked for: if the open slot changes again before the frame, the restore applies to the newest slot (usually right) and is lost if the window is locked or closed. No bug found today.
fix: Store Option<(ChatId, DraftTopic)> so the restore names what asked and is dropped when the slot differs.

title: drop_paths / drop_state / drop_preview are three fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Drag files over the conversation: drop_zones.rs sets drop_paths and clears drop_state, an async probe fills drop_state only if drop_paths still equals what was probed; leave/drop clear both.
effect: Matched by a path-list compare, so it works today; two fields must change together in four places (drop_zones.rs:41,65,77,91).
fix: enum DragOver { None, Probing(paths), Ready(paths, DragState) } plus the demo's fixed preview as its own variant.

title: slow_mode_tick_chat: Option<ChatId> doubles as 'task running' flag
trigger: Open gated chat A (tick task starts), switch to gated B then back to A within 1 s.
effect: Two tick tasks run for A until one sees the gate lift (ensure_slow_mode_tick sets the field to A again and spawns another, the first is still alive). Harmless extra redraws; the field is a hand-kept 'Some exactly while the task runs'.
fix: Hold the tick as Option<(ChatId, Task<()>)> so replacing it drops the old task (stage and owner in one value).

title: TextLimitCount holds known and running as two Cells kept in step by hand
trigger: Type or paste text over 16 KB in the composer
effect: known (last counted key and note) and running (key and task) are set and taken in set/is_counting; a state of 'known for K1, running for K2' exists by design and is guarded only by key comparison
fix: enum TextLimitCount { Idle, Known(key, note), Counting { key, task, last: Option<..> } }.

title: Connection card is two fields written together at five sites: connection.status and auth_demo.demo_state (plus the note)
trigger: Start a connection, hit a blocker (no credentials, close unconfirmed, startup failure), retry
effect: start_connection sets Live+WaitTdlibParameters, open_client sets Blocked+StartupFailed or NeedCredentials+WaitPhoneNumber, the close-unconfirmed branch sets Blocked+StartupFailed; a site that sets one and not the other shows the wrong card; DiskFull and LockedStore leave Live+WaitTdlibParameters and a 'Connecting' note
fix: One enum ConnectStage { Connecting, NeedCredentials, Blocked(StartupFailure), Live } with the card and note derived from it.

title: ConnectionUi note, toasts and toast_wake are three fields changed together by clear_note/drop_toasts/advance_toasts
trigger: Show an error note, let its toast end, clear the note, switch windows
effect: clear_note resets note and toasts but not toast_wake; drop_toasts resets toasts and toast_wake but not note; advance_toasts drops note when the queue no longer holds it; each caller picks the variant that fits, so the pairs can disagree (a note with no toast, a pending wake with no toast)
fix: Make the toast queue own the current note and its wake deadline as one value.

title: Contacts list stage is derived from an Option plus a bool plus whether a request is in flight
trigger: Contacts tab open while the list is invalidated, fetched, or fails
effect: 'Loading' is `contacts.is_none() && !contacts_error` with no check that a GetContacts request exists, so loading and failed are two fields that must be kept in step by the driver (fetch_contacts, refetch_invalidated_contacts, error.rs)
fix: Fetch<T> for the contacts list; the view matches the variant.

title: MenuFocus keeps `was_open` and `previous` in step by hand
trigger: Open and close a context menu, including a close by account switch or window close
effect: previous is Some only while was_open; menu_focus_upkeep sets and clears both from a per-frame edge detection; a frame that never runs (window hidden) leaves previous focus stuck on the menu frame
fix: enum MenuFocusStage { Closed, Open { previous: Option<FocusHandle> } }.

title: Schedule popup is schedule_popup_open: bool beside schedule_picker: Option<SchedulePicker>
trigger: n/a
effect: Five writers clear the bool (toggle_composer_silent.rs:107/393, composer/mod.rs:567, send_prep.rs:450, scheduled.rs:362) and leave the picker Some. Only scheduled.rs:298 clears both.
fix: One Option<SchedulePicker> whose Some is 'open' (the picker carries its target).

title: History window anchoring is key + window_epoch + anchor_pending: bool + last_highlight, kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: anchor_pending (baseline debt) is set on a new window and cleared in rows_replaced, and is read by reselect_open_chat and remember_scroll.
fix: enum WindowAnchor { Anchoring { key, epoch }, Anchored { key, epoch } }.

title: Opened-history position is a set of loose fields: anchor_pending, landing, scroll_goal, last_highlight, window_epoch
trigger: Open a chat, replace a window (jump to latest, date jump), jump to a search hit, open a thread
effect: anchor_pending is a bool set in the Build branch and cleared in rows_replaced only when rows are non-empty (reselect_open_chat and remember_scroll silently return while it is set); landing, scroll_goal and last_highlight are cleared at different call sites (anchor_opened_history, reach_scroll_goal, advance_landing, mouse/scroll watchers)
fix: enum HistoryPosition { Settled, Anchoring, Landing(Landing), Goal(ScrollGoal) } replaced whole on a key change.

title: Chrome-notify pending flag and due list are two cells kept in step
trigger: Scroll a history with stale-chrome rows during a session change.
effect: chrome_notify_pending (Cell<bool>) says a deferred notify is scheduled while chrome_due holds the rows; finish_chrome_notify and clear_slot_chrome_notify must reset it for the right window or notifies stop.
fix: Make chrome_due an enum ChromeDue { Idle, Due(Vec<usize>), Notifying(Vec<usize>) } in one RefCell.

title: Custom emoji card stage spread over a per-window tap marker, a seen copy and a session-wide preview
trigger: Tap a custom emoji in a message.
effect: custom_emoji_tapped (window), custom_emoji_card_seen (window) and Session::stickers.custom_emoji_preview (session) are set, compared and cleared by hand in tap, render, timer and both buttons.
fix: One enum CustomEmojiCard { Hidden, Asked{emoji}, Shown{preview, shown_at} } per window, with the session preview only as the answer.

title: Deep-link flow origin is kept by hand in three places beside the flow state
trigger: Any link click
effect: The flow stage lives in Session::chats_state.deep_link while its origin (agent flag, asking window, window the resolved link waits for) is in ChatsState::deep_link_from_agent, LinkUi::flow_window and LinkUi::pending_flow_window; pump_deep_link takes and puts them back in step on every poll.
fix: One enum DeepLinkFlow { Idle, Resolving{origin}, Invite{origin,..}, Resolved{origin,result} } with Origin { agent, window } inside each variant.

title: A resolved link waiting for its frame is three fields: pending_deep_link_open, pending_deep_link_ui and one shared pending_flow_window
trigger: A chat open from the share chooser (choose_share_chat -> hold_resolved_link) while a typed-link UI step from another window is still waiting for its frame.
effect: Today the two kinds rarely overlap. When they do, the second hold_resolved_link overwrites pending_flow_window, and the first link's box or chat runs in the second link's window. The 'which frame runs it' answer comes from three Options read together in resolved_link_frame.
fix: One Option<ResolvedLink { window: Option<ChatId>, step: ResolvedStep::{Open(PendingOpen), Ui(DeepLinkUi)} }>, so each waiting step carries its own window and a new one replaces the old whole.

title: Deep link flow origin is spread over flow_window, pending_flow_window, pending_deep_link_ui, pending_deep_link_open and deep_link_invite
trigger: Click a t.me link in a chat window; the window travels in flow_window while the flow runs, then moves to pending_flow_window when the resolved link waits for render; each is taken by hand at each step.
effect: Origin fields must be moved/cleared in step with the payload; a missed take leaks the window to the next link.
fix: enum LinkFlow { Idle, Resolving{from}, Waiting{from, ui|open}, Asking{from, invite} } so the window cannot outlive its stage.

title: Update stream keeps two sequence counters (DemoUi::seq and Session::last_seq + 1) in step by hand
trigger: QUILL_DEMO_UPDATE_STREAM combined with any later demo action using demo_ui.seq
effect: The stream advances session.last_seq without advancing demo_ui.seq, so later demo envelopes are dropped as stale (see 09-P03-001)
fix: Have the stream number its envelopes through demo_ui.seq (copy_and_parse) so there is one counter.

title: Saved-GIF panel is open + loading bools beside the list, set by hand before the answer
trigger: Open the GIF panel
effect: No bug found here; fixture sets gifs.open = true and gifs.loading = true then applies the answer, which must clear loading
fix: GifPanel { open, items: Fetch<Vec<Gif>> }.

title: Device linking stage is three Options: scanner, scanned link, notice
trigger: n/a (side effect: paste a link while the camera scan runs; the scanner's later result overwrites the pasted link)
effect: device_qr_scanner, device_login_qr and device_link_notice can all be set at once; scan_device_qr checks two, paste_device_login_link checks one.
fix: `enum DeviceLink { Idle(Option<notice>), Scanning(DeviceQrScanner), Confirm(Zeroizing<String>), Linking(RequestId) }`.

title: Device-link flow is three Options kept in step by hand (scanner, scanned link, notice)
trigger: Settings > Devices > Link device: scan or paste, confirm, wait for Telegram
effect: No bug today; stages Idle / Scanning / AwaitingConsent / WaitingForTelegram / Done(notice) are spread over device_qr_scanner, device_login_qr and device_link_notice, with scan_device_qr and paste_device_login_link each re-checking a different subset
fix: One enum DeviceLink { Idle, Scanning(Scanner), Consent(link), Waiting, Result(DeviceLoginResult|Error) }; Waiting leaves on the DeviceLoginResult answer.

title: New Contact box stage kept in sent_name + sent_request + not_joined
trigger: n/a: editing / import in flight / not-joined note are three fields changed together in new_contact.rs:93-98, 128, 138, 194-196.
effect: n/a
fix: enum NewContactStage { Editing, Sending{request, name}, NotJoined{name} } (user_id != 0 boxes use Editing only).

title: AddContactDialog sent_name + sent_request + not_joined are one New Contact stage kept in step by hand
trigger: Window > Add Contact: Create, wait, Try someone else.
effect: Stages Form / Sending(request) / NotJoined are spread over three fields set in submit_new_contact (sent_name, sent_request, not_joined together, with a demo branch that sets not_joined and no request), take_new_contact_outcome and the retry button; the retry button must reset all three.
fix: enum NewContactStage { Form, Sending { request, name }, NotJoined { name } } on the dialog.
